spec.data: Shioaji TX ticks (provider tick_type aggressor) and 5-level bid/ask, aggregated to 1m; dominant contract per session
spec.qualityGate: a session is used only if captured TX volume is 90%-110% of the official 5m archive volume over the same 5m buckets AND the official archive has >= 95% of the session 5m buckets covered by captured ticks
spec.bars5m: 5m bars built from 1m (Taipei clock buckets); ATR14 on 5m rolled across sessions within a contract (official archive used for warm-up when the Shioaji day is missing)
spec.decisionPoints: every 5m bar close t in a usable session, from the 3rd 5m bar of the session, excluding the last 12 bars of the session
spec.base: momentum move: m = close_t - close_(t-15min); a decision point qualifies if |m| >= 0.5 * ATR14_5m; base direction = sign(m)

features.cvd15: (aggressor buy volume - aggressor sell volume) / total volume over the last 15 minutes (tick_type)
features.book5: mean over bid/ask snapshots in the last 5 minutes of (sum top-5 bid volume - sum top-5 ask volume) / (sum both)

spec.confirmed: feature has the same sign as the base direction AND |feature| >= the DEV-window 67th percentile of |feature| at qualifying points (threshold computed from DEV features only, then frozen and reused on HOLDOUT)
spec.opposed: feature has the opposite sign of the base direction (any magnitude)
spec.trade: enter at the open of the next 1m bar in the base direction; stop 1.5 x ATR14_5m; target 2R; time exit 60 minutes; session end exit; exits checked on 1m bars, a bar touching both counts as stop; TX costs (2 ticks per side)

primary.P1: cvd15: mean net R(confirmed) - mean net R(opposed)
primary.P2: book5: mean net R(confirmed) - mean net R(opposed)
primary.P3: 6-timeframe alignment incl. 1m (1,5,15,30,60,240; EMA20 direction as in V6; 5m+ from official archive closes rolled within contract, 1m EMA20 from Shioaji 1m closes reset each session): onsets of full alignment at 1m closes, one position at a time, vs same-hour same-direction random 1m entries (2000 draws), mean net R excess

spec.inference: P1/P2: one-sided p from 2000 within-day permutations of the feature among qualifying points (price paths fixed). P3: one-sided p vs matched controls. Holm across P1-P3. Pass = Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and positive effect. Tradable flag additionally requires mean net R of confirmed (or aligned) trades > 0.
secondary: tick-count imbalance (buy ticks - sell ticks)/(all) over 15m
basis lead (TX minus IX0001 change over 15m, DAY only)
veto view: opposed vs all qualifying points
